Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614361. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614361', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
